title: Lesson 3 Checkpoint — Plural Nouns
description: Show what you learned about plural nouns. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Plural Nouns: Most nouns add -s for plural. Learn high-frequency irregular plurals. Verb agreement: one book → it is; two books → they

questions.question: Complete: ___ have two cats.
